// diagnostic E0128

Jet.ZipLengthMismatch

Zip inputs have different lengths under `{msg}` policy

What

Zip inputs have different lengths under `{msg}` policy

Why

Strict `zip` requires every input to end on the same row.

Fix

Use `zip_short` to intentionally truncate or `zip_pad` to intentionally pad; neither changes strictness automatically.

Worked example
